name: HighLevel
summary: All-in-one CRM, funnel, texting, email and automation platform for agencies, with white-label options and a 14-day free trial.
best_for: marketing agencies and consultants who manage several clients and want CRM, funnels, texting, email and automation in one white-label platform
skip_if: you need a simple CRM for one small team, a flat price with no metered usage, or you do not want to spend time configuring a large platform
honest_knock: The headline plan price is only part of the bill: calls, SMS, email and AI features are usage-based and the add-ons are charged per sub-account. Billing starts automatically when the free trial ends, and the pricing page changes its plan names and annual figures between pages, so confirm the plan and amount at checkout.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter billed monthly, for one business or a few clients (3 sub-accounts per the FAQ)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on gohighlevel.com/pricing) HighLevel sells its agency CRM and marketing-automation platform in three published plans plus a custom Enterprise plan. Starter costs $97 a month ($970 a year) and is meant for one business or a few clients; the FAQ says it includes 3 sub-accounts. Unlimited costs $297 a month, for agencies managing unlimited clients, and adds a white-label desktop app, basic API access and pass-through billing for usage and add-ons. Founder costs $497 a month and adds SaaS mode with unlimited reselling, project management, meeting rooms and events. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and billing begins automatically at the end of the trial unless you cancel. The page shows annual prices next to the monthly ones, but the annual amounts on the Unlimited and Founder cards do not match their monthly plans in the page text we read, so we do not quote them. Usage-based charges apply to conversation AI, voice AI, reviews AI, email and SMS marketing and calling, and optional add-ons are billed on top, for example the AI Employee plans at $50 or $97 a month per sub-account, the branded client portal app at $49 a month per sub-account and HIPAA compliance at $297 a month. The FAQ says billing is month to month with no long-term contract.

compare_with.why: HubSpot is in our directory as a CRM and marketing suite sold by contacts and seats. HighLevel is built around agencies running many client sub-accounts under one login. We have not compared the two on price, so check both pricing pages against your client count
